name: Binding of Emrakul
description: The spell, built from Tamiyo's binding scroll, Jace's glyph and Nissa's power, that stretches Emrakul into the moon and seals her there.

description_citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
